reason: The README describes a protocol and reference integrations that let agent harnesses and gateways submit LLM events to a runtime and enforce returned safety or security verdicts, so plugin development is the closest primary category.

summaries.zh: 为智能体和模型网关提供统一的安全评估协议与集成钩子，以提交模型事件并根据运行时判定执行策略。
summaries.en: Provides a protocol and integration hooks for agent harnesses and model gateways to submit LLM events and enforce runtime safety or security verdicts.

capabilities: Observes and forwards raw LLM request and response bodies to an evaluation runtime
Receives safety or security verdicts for agent events
Can block model requests or agent actions based on returned verdicts
Integrates with agent harnesses and LLM gateways
